name: recall_project_decision
prompt: 上次 Atlas 项目决定使用哪个数据库？继续按那个决定写迁移计划。
expected: Checks or starts the NMG daemon before recall
Searches memory and loads selected exact evidence
Uses the recalled decision in the migration plan
Stops the daemon only when this invocation started it

name: remember_preference
prompt: 记住我今后希望中文简洁回答，然后告诉我保存结果。
expected: Stores a durable preference automatically
Includes short user evidence and a stable semantic node
Does not store unrelated conversation
Reports the saved result

name: shared_daemon
prompt: NMG daemon 已经由另一个 Agent 启动。查一下以前失败过的 Gazebo 方案，完成后不要影响其他 Agent。
expected: Reuses the existing daemon
Uses progressive search and exact get
Does not stop a daemon it did not start

name: semantic_recall_escalation
prompt: 用词法搜不到上次关于图形渲染修复的决定，看看能不能用语义搜索找到。
expected: Checks embedding health (nmg status --json) before semantic search
Escalates from lexical to --retrieval-mode hybrid when lexical is insufficient
Loads exact evidence with nmg get before using the recalled decision
Does not fabricate a recalled fact when the index is not ready

name: second_pass_recall
prompt: 同一个查询换一种说法搜不出来，试试不换查询直接加深证据选择。
expected: Uses --second-pass on the same query before rewriting it
Understands --second-pass re-selects within the same candidate pool
Loads only the selected exact records, not the whole pool

name: shared_task_board
prompt: 两个 Agent 正在协作 release-42。把解析器测试通过且下一步检查序列化器这个交接写到临时黑板，让另一个 Agent 增量读取；不要把它保存成长期记忆。
expected: Uses nmg board put with a stable task id and attributed agent id
Uses nmg board read with a cursor for the collaborating agent
Does not use nmg remember or semantic search for temporary coordination
Treats the board as expiring task state projected into each Agent's private AG

name: natural_outcome_collection
prompt: 这次真实任务里 NMG 找到并 get 了旧决定，随后测试工具明确验证该决定仍正确。把这次结果作为以后改进检索的自然证据，但不要把沉默或回答复用当作成功。
expected: Uses the session-owned activeGraphId to preserve search-to-get attribution
Records only directly observed feedback fields
Uses the smallest exact successful tool excerpt for claim_outcome
Keeps silence, lack of correction, retrieval, and answer reuse as unknown

name: gated_natural_calibration
prompt: NMG 已经积累了一批真实 Pi 使用数据。检查它是否足够训练控制器；如果足够就让 Agent 更新策略，如果不够就继续采集。不要把 benchmark 或 probe 冒充自然数据。
expected: Runs compact controller and natural-maintenance readiness audits
Treats controlled and legacy rows as ineligible natural supervision
Does not calibrate while dataset blockers remain
Creates a rollbackable candidate only after readiness
Applies a source or configuration update only after held-out matched quality and cost gates pass
